Subject: Recap + procurement next steps: PO vs. card vs. marketplace

Hi Daniel / Patricia — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

- Summary: demo covered latency/cost profiles, Dedicated vs Hosted options, and data residency controls. You mentioned primary goal is predictable unit cost for payment risk models and an aggressive go-live target in early Q1.
- Procurement path options discussed: corporate card (fastest), purchase order (standard for FinCo), or AWS Marketplace (if you prefer streamlined invoicing and procurement).
- Action items we agreed on:
  1) I’ll share a short SOW + pricing sheet for your legal/procurement.
  2) Please confirm which procurement channel you want to pursue (PO / card / marketplace).
  3) Identify the internal owner who will submit the PO and any required fields (vendor name, remit address, tax ID).

Attached: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW stub), Pricing_Sheet_Q4.xlsx (pricing stub).

If it helps, I can loop in our legal ops to accelerate standard PO terms. What’s your target date for having paperwork approved?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0173

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf), Pricing_Sheet_Q4.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Subject: Re: Recap + procurement next steps: PO vs. card vs. marketplace

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the materials. Quick notes from procurement: 

- Our preference is to go via PO + SOW for vendor onboarding (card for pilot teams is okay but enterprise finance prefers PO for anything beyond $10k/month).
- Procurement needs: vendor legal name, remit-to address, tax ID (EIN), and a short SOC 2 attestation. They also asked whether Redwood can provide a standard invoice template and whether you support change orders on the SOW.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace could simplify invoicing, but our legal team will still want to see vendor security docs. If you have Marketplace listing lead time, please share.

Goal: we'd like to have purchase paperwork in to Finance by Nov 20 to make the Dec billing cycle. Is that achievable?

—Daniel
Daniel Cho
Senior Procurement Manager | FinCo Payments
daniel.cho@finco.com
